records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: ● Total revenue of $317.4 million, an increase of 23.8% compared with the second quarter of 2021, and freight revenue (which excludes revenue from fuel surcharges) of $266.9 million, an increase of 15.0% compared with the second quarter of 2021;

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our asset-based segments, Expedited and Dedicated, contributed approximately 63% of total freight revenue in the quarter and performed well in an environment constrained by equipment shortages and sharp inflationary costs.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The addition of AAT in the first quarter of 2022 and improved pricing were able to overcome reduced utilization and significant cost increases from driver pay, fuel, insurance, parts and maintenance.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Our Expedited segment grew revenue and improved adjusted margins compared to the second quarter last year.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: ● Operating income of $26.9 million, compared with $18.3 million in the second quarter of 2021;
